title: Refill Cycle Terms — Testing Supplies Tiers
content:
Refills on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program follow a cycle whose length and lead times depend on the tier.

| Tier | Days of supply in one refill | Earliest refill reminder, days before the planned ship date | Earliest refill ship date, days before the previous supply ends | Customer confirms each refill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 | 7 | No |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 10 | 7 | Yes |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 10 | 10 | Yes |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | Yes |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | Yes |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 30 | 14 | 7 | Yes |

**Definitions**

- *Days of supply in one refill* — the standard calendar days one refill shipment covers, always a multiple of 30.
- *Earliest refill reminder* — the earliest point, in calendar days before the planned ship date, for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact.
- *Earliest refill ship date* — the earliest point, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of the same item, at which a refill may ship.
- *Customer confirms each refill* — whether each refill requires the customer's own confirmation of continued use and quantity on hand before it ships. "No" means subscription shipping on schedule.

**Reading example (hypothetical dates).** On a tier with 90 days of supply and a 10-day ship lead, a refill shipped on day 0 covers through day 90, so the next refill of that item may ship from day 80. On a 30-day tier with a 7-day lead, the same reading gives day 23.
